verdict.rationale: Grok is itself an AI assistant/agent product; the evidence only shows it acting as an MCP-style client (connecting to external tools, APIs, tunneled local servers) via its 'connectors' feature, not exposing itself as an official MCP server for other agents to connect to. Per the agent-role exception, serving as an MCP server is a different axis and no evidence shows Grok running in that role.
